feature: CAD upload runs cost + DFM analysis
story: As a manufacturing engineer, I want to drop a CAD file (STL/STEP/STP/IGES/IGS) so that the part is costed and DFM-analyzed in one pass.
expected: Cold-start dropzone accepts CAD_ACCEPT types; on drop it fires POST /api/proxy/validate/cost (multipart: file, qty, cavities, complexity, material_class, units, optional shop/overrides) and POST /api/proxy/validate?units=... in parallel. Unsupported extension shows 'Unsupported file type' error without any request; an invalid qty list opens the options panel with 'Fix the quantity list before submitting.' Loading panes show per-tab spinner copy; session cookie is forwarded by the same-origin proxy (page redirects to /login when unauthenticated).
evidence: frontend/src/app/(app)/analyze/page.tsx; frontend/src/components/workspace/PartWorkspace.tsx L341-358, L307-339, L454-497; frontend/src/lib/api.ts L980-1063; frontend/src/app/(app)/layout.tsx L35

story: As an engineer, I want tabs (Decision, Routing & DFM, Glass Box, Compare, History) and a Role Lens so that I can view the same report through my role's landing lens without anything being walled off.
expected: /analyze lands on the 'mfg' role whose lens maps to the Routing & DFM tab; changing the role switches the landing tab (cost role also opens the Inspector). Glass Box and Compare tabs show EmptyState ('No cost breakdown yet' / 'Nothing to compare yet') until a cost report exists. 'New part' resets all state back to the dropzone.

story: As a manufacturing engineer, I want DFM findings linked to the 3D part so that clicking a face or a blocker highlights the exact geometry.
expected: On the Routing tab, clicking a mesh face that belongs to an issue's affected_faces_sample selects that issue and highlights its faces in a severity-mapped hex color (ghosting the rest); selecting an issue in the list highlights its faces. Highlighting a process with no geometry-linked faces raises a toast 'No geometry-linked faces reported for <process>'.

story: As a cost engineer, I want to bind a shop profile, override rates, and save scenarios so that estimates use real calibrated numbers I can recall.
expected: GET /api/proxy/shops populates bindable shop profiles; selecting one re-runs POST /validate/cost with shop=<id> and toasts 'Calibrating to <name>…'. Applying an override or cavity count re-costs server-side with overrides JSON; 'Clear overrides' resets them. 'Save as scenario' stores a session-local chip (label = shop · overrides · qty) whose click recalls those options and re-costs; scenarios are lost on reset.

story: As a user, I want honest failure states so that a broken mesh or server error tells me what to do instead of a blank screen.
expected: A 400 with code GEOMETRY_INVALID from POST /validate/cost renders the CostGeometryInvalidCard (reason + measured geometry) and a 'Geometry invalid' badge instead of a generic error. Other cost failures render ErrorState with a Retry that re-costs; DFM failure renders 'Analysis unavailable' with retry re-running POST /validate. 429 and 5xx raise toasts ('Rate limit exceeded…', 'Server error. We've been notified.').

story: As an engineer, I want unit-ambiguity warnings and a lineage Inspector so that I can trust and trace the numbers.
expected: report.unit_warnings render in a persistent UnitWarningBanner until the user confirms mm vs inch and re-costs (re-cost re-runs BOTH cost and DFM with the declared units). The collapsible DecisionInspector anchors to the make-now stable-quantity estimate and exposes Lineage/Governance/Sources/Audit tabs (defaults to Sources for the cost role); overrides applied from it trigger a real server re-cost.

feature: History tab: scenarios, copy summary, durable artifact
story: As a user, I want a History tab so that I can recall session scenarios, copy a decision summary, and jump to durable cost decisions.
expected: With no report, EmptyState 'No history yet'. With a report: saved scenario chips (click recalls + re-costs), 'Open cost history' navigates to /cost-decisions, and 'Copy decision summary' writes a plaintext make-by/crossover/DFM summary to the clipboard (success/failure toasts). When the authed cost route persisted the decision (report.saved present and cost-persist UI flag on), a CostArtifactBar offers open/PDF/JSON/CSV/share actions against /cost-decisions/{id} endpoints.

story: As a user, I want to open a saved analysis from history so that I can review its full DFM dashboard.
expected: GET /api/proxy/analyses/{id} on mount; spinner while loading; on failure renders 'Analysis not found' ErrorState with a 'Back to history' link. Success renders the filename/file-type/date header and the full AnalysisDashboard from result_json.

story: As a user, I want to create and revoke a public share link so that others can view the analysis without an account.
expected: 'Share' calls POST /api/proxy/analyses/{id}/share and opens a modal with the returned share_url; when shared, a revoke path calls DELETE on the same endpoint and returns the button to unshared state. Failures toast the API error message.

story: As a user, I want to download the DFM report as PDF so that I can circulate it.
expected: Button fetches GET /api/proxy/analyses/{id}/pdf and triggers a browser download named '<stem>-dfm-report.pdf'; shows 'Generating PDF…' while loading and toasts on failure.

story: As a user, I want to attempt automatic mesh repair on a broken analysis so that I can compare before/after results.
expected: 'Attempt mesh repair' renders ONLY when universal_issues include a repairable code (NON_WATERTIGHT, INCONSISTENT_NORMALS, NOT_SOLID_VOLUME, DEGENERATE_FACES, MULTIPLE_BODIES). Since the original file is not stored, clicking opens a file picker to re-select it, then POST /api/proxy/validate/repair; success swaps the dashboard for a RepairComparison view; failure toasts.
evidence: frontend/src/components/RepairButton.tsx L11-37, L40-58; frontend/src/app/(app)/analyses/[id]/page.tsx L95-99, L134-142; frontend/src/lib/api.ts L562-588

story: As a user, I want to see cost decisions linked to this analysis so that I can jump to the sourcing record.
expected: When analysis.decision_links is non-empty, a 'Linked cost decisions' card lists each decision (filename, make-now process or 'No make-now route', approval_status) with an 'Open decision' button that navigates to decision.url; card is absent otherwise.

feature: Paginated analysis history with verdict filter
story: As a user, I want a filterable list of my past analyses so that I can find and reopen any run.
expected: GET /api/proxy/analyses?limit=20[&verdict=][&cursor=] with cursor 'Load more' pagination capped at 500 loaded rows ('N analyses loaded.'). Verdict Select (all/pass/issues→Advisory/fail→Required) resets and reloads. Row click navigates to /analyses/{ulid}. Empty state 'No analyses yet' with an 'Analyze a part' CTA to /analyze; load errors render ErrorState with retry.

story: As a user, I want to see my rate-limit usage so that I know how much quota remains.
expected: QuotaDisplay renders X-RateLimit-Remaining/Limit headers captured from the analyses list response as a used/total progress bar with 'Resets in N min'; before any response arrives it shows 'Quota data unavailable'.

story: As a design engineer, I want the app home to be a drop-a-part should-cost workspace so that I get the make-vs-buy answer first.
expected: Flag-off (NEXT_PUBLIC_STAGE_UI unset, the default) renders the identical PartWorkspace as /analyze but with defaultRole='design', landing on the Decision tab; all APP-001..007 behaviors apply. Uses the same POST /validate/cost + POST /validate pair.

story: As a returning user (staged build), I want the home to remember my chosen door so that I land in my persona's workspace.
expected: Only when NEXT_PUBLIC_STAGE_UI=1: LandingRouter resolves door from localStorage cv_door, else from session role, else shows the first-run DoorChooser; picking persists and routes (part/cost-catalog/portfolio doors), cross-nav peeks without re-persisting. Flag-off this code is never loaded — expected behavior on default builds is APP-015.

story: As a cost engineer, I want a list of saved should-cost decisions so that I can reopen, share-check, and govern them.
expected: GET /api/proxy/cost-decisions?limit=20 with cursor pagination (cap 500). Columns: label/filename, make-now process, crossover qty, quantities, Shared badge, governance badge (Stale=warn > Approved=pass > Unreviewed=neutral), relative time. Row click → /cost-decisions/{id}. Empty state 'No saved cost decisions yet' with 'Cost a part' CTA to /cost; header 'Compare decisions' button routes to /cost-decisions/compare; a CostHonestyNote renders above the table.

story: As a cost engineer, I want the full saved decision with PDF/JSON/CSV export so that I can hand off an auditable artifact.
expected: GET /api/proxy/cost-decisions/{id} on mount (spinner; 'Cost decision not found' ErrorState with back link on failure/404 for non-owners). Header shows label/filename, source SHA-256 mesh hash, and export buttons: PDF (GET .../pdf → <stem>-cost-report.pdf), JSON (GET .../export.json), CSV (GET .../export.csv); export failures toast. Body renders SavedCostDecisionView of the verbatim result.

story: As an analyst, I want to sign off or reopen a saved decision so that RFQ/sourcing use is gated on review.
expected: For roles passing canMutateWorkspace: 'Approve' POSTs /cost-decisions/{id}/approve with an optional note (≤1000 chars); badge flips to Approved with 'Signed off by user N on <date>' and the approval note card. 'Reopen' DELETEs the same endpoint. Stale decisions show a warn card 'Re-cost before relying on this record' with stale_reason/date. Read-only roles see badges but no buttons.

story: As an analyst, I want to record the four-way sourcing outcome with a note so that reviewers see what the org decided.
expected: Disposition buttons PUT /cost-decisions/{id}/disposition {disposition, note}; 'Make in-house' is disabled with tooltip when the route DFM is blocked (derived from the make-now estimate). Withdraw sends disposition:null. Changing outcome or note while approved reopens approval (toast says so). Errors render 'Nothing changed — <msg>' inline; read-only roles see the recorded outcome and note only.

story: As an analyst, I want to share the decision publicly or bundle it as an RFQ ZIP so that suppliers can receive evidence.
expected: Share button (mutators only) POST/DELETE /cost-decisions/{id}/share, showing the public URL modal. 'RFQ ZIP' (mutators only) POSTs /rfq-packages with decision_ids=[id] and title 'RFQ package - <filename>', then downloads GET /rfq-packages/{pkgId}/download.zip; success/failure toasts.

story: As a cost engineer, I want a side-by-side diff of two saved decisions so that I can see which is cheaper at each quantity.
expected: GET /cost-decisions?limit=100 fills two Select pickers (same id disabled on the other side); with fewer than 2 decisions renders 'You need at least two saved cost decisions to compare' with a 'Cost a part' link. Compare button (disabled unless two distinct ids) calls GET /api/proxy/cost-decisions/compare?ids=A,B and renders summary cards plus a per-quantity unit-cost table where the cheaper side is highlighted and Δ (USD/%) is tone-colored; compare errors render ErrorState.

story: As a user, I want to upload a ZIP of parts (with optional CSV manifest, webhook, concurrency) so that many parts are DFM-analyzed at once.
expected: Only .zip up to 5 GB accepted (toasts otherwise). Submit runs the direct-upload path (GET /uploads/capabilities, multipart part uploads, complete) with staged progress copy (checking/hashing/preparing/uploading/retrying/completing/proxying/creating) and automatic per-part retry messaging, then POST /api/proxy/batch (webhook_url, manifest, concurrency 1-100); success routes to /batch/{batch_id}. Distinct error states: pre-create failure ('No batch was created… retry'), unconfirmed creation ('Check Recent batches before retrying'), and accepted-but-durably-failed batch with an 'Inspect failed batch' link. A single-flight lock prevents double submission.
evidence: frontend/src/components/batch/BatchUploadForm.tsx L84-140, L157-244; frontend/src/lib/api/batch.ts L238; frontend/src/lib/api/direct-upload.ts L304, L466, L664-726

feature: Recent batches list with CSV download
story: As a user, I want my recent batches listed so that I can open one or grab its results CSV.
expected: GET /api/proxy/batches?limit=20 with cursor 'Load more'. Rows show truncated ULID, StatusBadge, completed/total (+failed/skipped counts), created date; row click → /batch/{ulid}. 'Download CSV' appears only for completed/failed batches and fetches GET /batch/{id}/results/csv as batch_<id>_results.csv. Errors show retryable ErrorState; empty state 'No batches yet'.
evidence: frontend/src/app/(app)/batch/page.tsx L30-60, L113-196; frontend/src/lib/api/batch.ts L274, L297

story: As a user, I want live progress and per-item results so that I can watch a batch complete and open item analyses.
expected: BatchProgressBar polls GET /api/proxy/batch/{id} on an interval until a terminal status (completed/failed/cancelled); item changes trigger a refresh of BatchItemsTable (GET /batch/{id}/items, cursored) showing filename, status, verdict, best process, issue count, errors, and links to created analyses. 'Download CSV' appears only when completed/failed.

story: As a user, I want to cancel a non-terminal batch so that pending items are skipped.
expected: 'Cancel batch' shows only for non-terminal statuses and opens an AlertDialog ('Pending items will be skipped. This cannot be undone.'); confirm POSTs /api/proxy/batch/{id}/cancel, toasts 'Batch cancelled' and refreshes items; failure toasts the error.

story: As an analyst, I want to generate real CAD from plate/bracket/enclosure templates with mm dimensions so that I get revisioned, verifiable geometry.
expected: POST /api/proxy/designs {name, plan, design_note} after client-side validateDesignForm; template picker adjusts fields (plate adds corner-hole options; enclosure swaps thickness for wall). While status='generating' the list polls GET /designs every 1.5s; failed generation renders a fail card with the engine error and 'Revise and retry'. A DesignApiError carrying the failed design inserts it into the list and enters revision mode. Single-flight lock prevents duplicate submits; viewers (non-mutating roles) see a read-only library card instead of the form.
evidence: frontend/src/app/(app)/designs/page.tsx L215-222, L340-389, L455-618, L704-727; frontend/src/lib/designs-api.ts L189-209

story: As an analyst, I want to describe a shape in words so that the form is prefilled from local rules without AI egress.
expected: 'Interpret safely' POSTs /api/proxy/designs/interpret {prompt}; status 'ready' fills the whole form from the returned plan with a green message+assumptions; 'needs_input' partially prefills recognized dimensions and shows an amber message. Empty description shows 'Describe the starting shape and its dimensions first.'

feature: Revision history, preview, STEP download, verify hand-off
story: As a user, I want each revision's immutable preview, hash and STEP so that I can inspect, download, and verify exact geometry.
expected: Selecting a design loads GET /designs/{id}/revisions; revision chips switch the CadViewer to GET /designs/{id}/revisions/{n}/preview.stl?hash=… and show envelope/volume/STEP size/geometry hash. Ready revisions offer a STEP download link (GET .../revisions/{n}/download.step) and (mutators only) a 'Verify revision N' link to /verify?design=…&revision=N. Creating a revision POSTs /designs/{id}/revisions; 'Revise' is disabled while generating.
evidence: frontend/src/app/(app)/designs/page.tsx L224-273, L331-338, L673-806; frontend/src/lib/designs-api.ts L220-258

story: As an analyst, I want to archive a design so that it leaves the library while audit evidence is retained.
expected: Trash icon (mutators only, disabled while generating) opens window.confirm('Archive "<name>"? Its audit evidence will be retained.'); confirm DELETEs /api/proxy/designs/{id} and removes the card from the list; failure shows a dismissible error banner.

feature: Dev-only gate for the labeling tool
story: As an operator, I want the labeling tool disabled outside local operator environments so that production users see an honest disabled state.
expected: When DEV_TOOLS_ENV is false the page renders only an EmptyState 'Labeling backend disabled — available only in local operator environments' and issues no corpus requests. This is expected behavior, not a bug.

story: As a labeler, I want a keyboard-driven queue of unlabeled parts so that I can record ground-truth manufacturing methods quickly.
expected: Loads GET /api/proxy/corpus/parts?unlabeled_only=true&limit=200&labeler=… and GET /corpus/progress?labeler=… (badge 'X / Y labeled'); backend-unreachable shows 'Could not reach the labeling backend… LABELING_ENABLED=1?'. Each part shows the STL via GET /corpus/parts/{id}/mesh.stl plus metadata and an explicitly 'NOT a label' heuristic-guess warning. Ontology buttons (or hotkeys 1-6) POST /corpus/labels {part_id,label,labeler,confidence,notes} then advance; arrows navigate, 's' skips; finishing shows 'Queue complete' with a reload action; empty corpus shows 'No parts in the corpus queue'.

feature: Capability gating and honest disabled states
story: As a user, I want the Image-to-3D page to tell me truthfully whether reconstruction is enabled for my workspace and role so that I never upload into a dead end.
expected: GET /api/proxy/reconstruct/capability on mount: while loading shows 'Checking Image-to-3D availability…'; fetch failure shows retryable ErrorState. available:false renders 'Image-to-3D is not enabled' with the backend message, an assurance that no image was sent anywhere, and a 'Verify CAD instead' button to capability.verify_path. available but can_submit:false renders 'read-only for your account' (analyst+ required) with a 'Review analyses' button. When requires_egress_acknowledgement, the uploader stays disabled until the third-party-transfer checkbox is ticked.

feature: Submit photos and poll the reconstruction job
story: As an analyst, I want to upload up to 4 photos and watch the job run so that I get an estimated mesh with an idempotent, retry-safe submission.
expected: ImageUploader accepts jpg/png/webp, max 4 files, 20 MB each. Submit POSTs /api/proxy/reconstruct (multipart images) with an Idempotency-Key reused for network-ambiguous retries of the same files and X-Reconstruction-Egress-Acknowledged when acknowledged; response {job_id, estimated_seconds} moves to a processing step that polls GET /jobs/{id} then GET /jobs/{id}/result. Terminal worker failure resets to upload with a toast and a fresh submission id on retry.
evidence: frontend/src/app/(app)/reconstruct/page.tsx L66-131, L256-267; frontend/src/lib/api.ts L658-721; frontend/src/app/(app)/reconstruct/reconstruction-attempt.ts; components/ImageUploader.tsx L13-16

feature: Mesh preview with confidence and analysis hand-off
story: As an analyst, I want the reconstructed mesh previewed with an honest confidence score so that I can judge it before using its DFM analysis.
expected: Preview step renders the mesh from GET /api/proxy/reconstructions/{jobId}/mesh.stl with confidence percent/level and face count from the job result; a 'partial' terminal status shows an amber 'completed with limited output — review before using' banner plus a warning toast. 'Go to analysis' routes to /analyses/{analysisId} only when the job attached one; 'Start new reconstruction' resets the wizard.

feature: Offline CSV connector catalog and runs
story: As an ops user, I want to run ERP/PLM/actual-cost CSVs through offline connectors so that imports are parsed and recorded without live credentials.
expected: On load GET /api/proxy/integrations/connectors and GET /integrations/runs?limit=25 (failure toasts). Connector cards state source system/kind, raw-stored and live-creds flags. 'Run' (disabled without a file) POSTs multipart /integrations/runs {connector_id, mode: dry_run|import, file}; success prepends the run and toasts 'Dry-run recorded'/'Import recorded'. Recent-runs table shows status (passed/partial/failed with color), valid/total rows with flagged count, mode, SHA-256 prefix, completion time; empty state 'No connector runs yet.'

story: As a user, I want a durable inbox of workflow notifications so that I can open, read, and triage verification/governance events.
expected: On load two GETs of /api/proxy/notifications?status=open&unread=false&dismissed={false,true}&limit=100 populate Inbox and Dismissed columns; load failure shows the error with 'Try again'; empty inbox says 'You're all caught up.' 'Mark all read' POSTs /notifications/read-all and stamps every row read. 'Open' POSTs /notifications/{id}/read then navigates to the mapped Verify destination (modified-clicks fire read in the background and let the browser navigate); a read failure still navigates.

story: As a user, I want to dismiss and later restore notifications so that my inbox stays clean without losing history.
expected: Dismiss POSTs /notifications/{id}/dismiss and moves the row to the Dismissed column with its timestamp; Restore POSTs /notifications/{id}/restore and returns it to the inbox with its prior read state. Failures render a 'Nothing changed — <msg>' alert with a 'Reload inbox' action; copy states dismissal changes only the user's inbox, never audit records.

feature: Build an RFQ package from cost decisions
story: As a sourcing user, I want to select saved cost decisions and generate a supplier evidence bundle so that suppliers get governed artifacts.
expected: On load GET /api/proxy/rfq-packages?limit=50 and GET /cost-decisions?limit=100 in parallel. The decision table flags stale/unapproved rows; selecting any risky decision shows an amber 'package will preserve those warnings' banner. 'Generate package (N)' (disabled with 0 selected) POSTs /rfq-packages {decision_ids, title, supplier_name, note, include_raw_cad} and prepends the package with a success toast; failures toast.

feature: Generated packages list with ZIP download
story: As a sourcing user, I want my generated packages listed with warnings so that I can download the ZIP or inspect details.
expected: Table shows title/supplier, approved/item counts, warnings count (green 'clear' or amber count), creation date; title click → /rfq-packages/{id}; 'ZIP' fetches GET /rfq-packages/{id}/download.zip as <title>-rfq.zip. Empty state 'No RFQ packages yet.'

story: As a sourcing user, I want a package's stats, warnings and item flags so that I can vet the bundle before sending it.
expected: GET /api/proxy/rfq-packages/{id} on mount ('Loading...' then 'RFQ package not found.' on failure, with Back). Renders stat cards (Approved x/y, Stale, Unvalidated, Raw CAD yes/no), a warnings card when warnings exist (code + message), and an items table with per-decision flags (stale/unvalidated/raw CAD or 'clear') and manifest match; decision names link to /cost-decisions/{id}; 'Download ZIP' fetches the bundle.

story: As a new user, I want /onboarding to take me to the Verify welcome flow so that legacy links keep working.
expected: Server component immediately issues redirect('/verify?welcome=1'); no UI is rendered and no API is called.

story: As a developer, I want to create, rotate and revoke API keys so that I control programmatic access.
expected: Server-side list via GET backend /api/v1/keys with the forwarded dash_session cookie; empty state offers 'Create key'. Create POSTs /api/proxy/keys {name:'Default'}, rotate POSTs /api/proxy/keys/{id}/rotate, revoke DELETEs /api/proxy/keys/{id}; buttons stay disabled until hydrated, toast success/error with the backend detail, and refresh the table. Revoked keys show a fail badge and lose their action buttons; key column shows only cv_live_<prefix>_… .

story: As a developer, I want the new key secret revealed exactly once so that it is never re-displayed.
expected: After create/rotate, RevealOnceModal reads the cv_mint_once cookie (event-driven plus a 250ms poll for up to 10s), shows the token with copy + acknowledge, and immediately expires the cookie so a reload cannot re-reveal. The page also links to /api-reference and the /scalar API console.

story: As a non-admin, I want an honest 'Admins only' state so that the org surface never half-renders; as a multi-org user I want to switch my active org.
expected: Server component loads GET /api/v1/orgs (cookie-forwarded); when the active org role is not 'admin' (or no org) it renders only the switcher and an 'Admins only' EmptyState naming the user's actual role. The switcher POSTs /api/v1/orgs/switch {org_id}, verifies the server echoed the same org, and revalidates the layout.

story: As an org admin, I want to invite teammates and remove members so that membership stays current.
expected: Members table from GET /api/v1/orgs/members with a remove action (DELETE /orgs/members/{userId}); backend errors — e.g. last-admin protection — surface verbatim via the {ok:false,error} action result. InviteForm POSTs /orgs/invites {email, role} and returns an accept_link plus emailed flag (link shown for manual forwarding when email isn't configured); pending invites can be revoked (DELETE /orgs/invites/{id}); statuses render tone-coded badges (pending/accepted/expired/revoked).

feature: SAML group-mapping CRUD and SSO/SCIM status
story: As an org admin, I want to map IdP groups to org roles and see my SSO endpoints so that JIT provisioning works.
expected: Mappings CRUD: GET/POST/DELETE /api/v1/orgs/saml/group-mappings (attribute_name, group_value, org_role); duplicates surface the backend error. Read-only SSO panel probes backend /auth/saml/metadata and /auth/oidc/status server-side and maps 200→Reachable, 404→'Not enabled in this deployment', other→'check config', displaying exact ACS/metadata/login/callback/SCIM URLs with contextual hints — explicitly not an editable form.

story: As an org admin, I want a live dependency health readout so that I can see platform status without ops tooling.
expected: Server-side probe of backend /health/deep (503 body is read as a real degraded state): renders Postgres, Redis (healthy/unhealthy/not-configured), worker heartbeat state (ok/stale/unknown), and queue depth. When the endpoint is unreachable it renders a fail card saying the readout 'degrades gracefully rather than fabricating a status'.

story: As a magic-link user, I want to set an initial password once so that I can also log in with credentials.
expected: When AUTH_MODE is password/hybrid: form validates client-side (8-128 chars, letter + digit, matching confirmation) then POSTs same-origin /api/auth/password/initialize {password}; success clears the form and shows 'Password configured. Older dashboard sessions were revoked.'; API errors render the backend detail. When AUTH_MODE is anything else, the page renders only an 'Enterprise identity' card stating password setup is disabled and the IdP controls sign-in — an honest disabled state.

story: As a designer/developer, I want a live showcase of every glass-box component rendered against a real fixture report so that I can verify the design language in both themes and all role lenses.
expected: Static page (no API calls) rendering working components — provenance chips, confidence intervals, driver breakdowns, routing card, DFM matrix, calibration bar, decision headline, crossover chart — from a hard-coded engine fixture (object.stl), with an interactive ThemeToggle and RoleLens; interactions raise demo toasts only and persist nothing.
